apply_page.statutory_annual_info: BCEA §20: Malatsi a tiro a le {minDays} a boikhutso jwa ngwaga mo sedikong. {accrual}
apply_page.statutory_sick_info: BCEA §23: Boikhutso jwa bolwetse bo lekanngwa mo sedikong sa dingwaga di le 3 (malatsi a le 36 mo bekeng ya malatsi a le 5). Setifikeiti sa bongaka se a tlhokega morago ga malatsi a le 2 a a latelanang, ka Mosupologo/Labotlhano, kgotsa fa palogotlhe e e giniikang ya dibeke di le 8 e feta malatsi a le 6.
apply_page.statutory_frl_info: BCEA §27: Malatsi a le {cap} a Boikhutso jwa Maikarabelo a Lelapa mo sedikong sengwe le sengwe sa boikhutso jwa ngwaga. Ditiragalo tse di tshwanelegang: go tsholwa ga ngwana, bolwetse jwa ngwana, loso lwa tokololo ya lelapa le le gaufi.
apply_page.statutory_maternity_info: BCEA §25: Dikgwedi di le 4 tse di latelanang tsa boikhutso jwa boimana jo bo sa duelelweng. Letamo la boikhutso jwa botsadi le le dumeletsweng le tshwanetse go kwadiswa le HR pele ga go dira kopo.
apply_page.statutory_parental_info: Van Wyk 2025 / BCEA §25A: Boikhutso jwa botsadi bo tlhoka letamo le le dumeletsweng le le kwadisitsweng ke HR. Diura tse di abetsweng di tswa mo letamong; melao ya boikhutso jwa nako e le nngwe e a dira.
apply_page.statutory_study_info: Boikhutso jwa go ithuta bo mo tlase ga tumello ya botsamaisi le ditokomane tsa tshegetso (bosupi jwa go kwadisa / kitsiso ya tlhatlhobo).
apply_page.statutory_unpaid_info: Boikhutso jo bo sa duelelweng bo ka se duelelwe. Tumello e mo go tlhogo ya lefapha la gago le HR.

governance_totp_setup.step1: Tsenya Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, kgotsa Authy mo mogaleng wa gago.
governance_totp_setup.step2: Thepha + mme o skene khoutu ya QR e e fa tlase.

governance_totp_setup.hide_secret: Fitha senotlelo sa go tsenya ka seatla
governance_totp_setup.code_label: Tsenya khoutu ya dinomoro di le 6 go tswa mo motlhomong wa gago
governance_totp_setup.error_default: Khoutu e e sa siamang. Tsweetswee leka gape.
governance_totp_setup.right_description: Maloko a boto a bereka ka tlase ga ditlhokego tsa tshireletso tse di kwa godimo. MFA ya motlhomo wa netefatso e netefatsa gore ke batho ba ba letleletsweng fela ba ba ka fitlhelelang ditshwetso tsa boto, diphuthelwana tsa kopano, le ditokomane tsa puso — le fa ditshupetso tsa go tsena di ka senyegile.

governance_totp_verify.code_hint: Khoutu e ntjhafala morago ga metsotswana e le 30
governance_totp_verify.error_default: Khoutu e e sa siamang kgotsa e e fedileng. Tsweetswee leka gape.
governance_totp_verify.security_note: Netefatso e e a tlhokega nako le nako fa o fitlhelela phothalo ya boto. Ikgolaganye le molaodi wa boto ya gago fa o latlhegetswe ke phitlhelelo ya motlhomo wa gago wa netefatso.
governance_totp_verify.right_title: Ke eng lebaka la kgato e e oketsegileng?
governance_totp_verify.right_description: Data ya puso — ditshwetso tsa boto, dipegelo tsa madi, le metsotso ya dikopano — e botlhokwa thata. Netefatso ya motlhomo wa netefatso e netefatsa gore ga go ope yo o ka fitlhelelang tshedimosetso eno ka phasewete e e utswitsweng fela.
